question: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY), launched in April 2005 under the National Rural Health Mission, is a conditional cash transfer scheme that provides a cash incentive to promote institutional delivery, with higher benefits for women in low-performing states.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is actually true. JSY (April 2005, NRHM/NHM) is a conditional cash transfer tied to institutional delivery, with higher incentives for low-performing states. Review the JSY design and objectives under OG1.5.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. JSY was launched in April 2005 as part of NRHM (now NHM). It is a conditional cash transfer — the cash incentive is conditional on institutional delivery. Low-performing states (LPS) such as UP, Bihar, MP, Rajasthan, and Jharkhand receive higher cash benefits than high-performing states (HPS).
